append.detail: UPDATE 2026-11-10 (ratchet seeded): scripts/block-baselines.json and check:block-baselines (in the checks guards array) hold block-systems at 5 with check:adoption's provenance rules: a rise is refused, a fall is written down with --update --reason, and the basis fingerprints the manifest of the five system entry points. The other five section-7.3 keys (block-types-total, unbound-app-surfaces, blocks-without-totext, raw-css-paths, editor-bytes-on-public-render) are NOT seeded: each needs a counter nobody has run, and an unmeasured baseline is the failure the section exists to prevent.
